title: Simulation 3D CubeSat Pack
text: Create translation and rotation input matrices for CubeSat, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Select input coordinate frame} sets Input coordinate frame; {Antenna 1 translation} sets the option to enable Antenna1_T input port, {Antenna 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Antenna1_R input port, {Antenna 2 translation} sets the option to enable Antenna2_T input port, {Antenna 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Antenna2_R input port, {Antenna 3 translation} sets the option to enable Antenna3_T input port, {Antenna 3 rotation} sets the option to enable Antenna3_R input port, {Sensor translation} sets the option to enable Sensor_T input port, {Sensor rotation} sets the option to enable Sensor_R input port, {Solar array 1 translation} sets the option to enable SolarArray1_T input port, {Solar array 1 rotation} sets the option to enable SolarArray1_R input port, {Solar array 1.1 translation} sets the option to enable SolarArray1_1_T input, {Solar array 1.1 rotation} sets the option to enable SolarArray1_1_R input, {Solar array 2 translation} sets the option to enable SolarArray2_T input port, {Solar array 2 rotation} sets the option to enable SolarArray2_R input port, {Solar array 2.2 translation} sets the option to enable SolarArray2_2_T input, {Solar array 2.2 rotation} sets the option to enable SolarArray2_2_R input, {Thruster translation} sets the option to enable Thruster_T input port and {Thruster rotation} sets the option to enable Thruster_R input port. Values come from the instance.
